enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Shift legs. Move arm. Remain asleep.

Wake up. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and spoon. Close cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk. Stand up. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in sink. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt and pants. Close closet. Open drawer. Take out socks and underwear. Close drawer. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on socks. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on shoes. Walk to bathroom. Look in mirror. Comb hair. Walk out.
Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to desk.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Take notes. Return to desk. Make phone calls. Write reports. Type on keyboard. Use mouse. Talk to colleagues. Print documents. File paperwork.

Walk to cafeteria. Stand in line. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk with colleagues. Clear tray. Throw trash. Walk outside. Walk back to office.

Sit at desk. Open computer. Review documents. Attend meeting. Take notes. Make phone calls. Write emails. Organize files. Collaborate with team. Use software. Print materials. Talk to supervisor. Update database. Prepare presentation. Log out.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door.
Walk into living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Flip through channels. Settle on a show. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Lean back. Stretch arms.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Cook. Turn off stove. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table. Wash dishes.
Sit on sofa. Turn on TV. Watch show. Change channels. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to sofa. Eat snack. Watch more TV.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Log in. Open project file. Type. Use mouse. Save file. Check email. Browse internet. Watch video. Chat with friend. Close computer. Turn off lamp.
Walk to living room. Pick up items from floor. Place on table. Fluff pillows. Fold blankets. Pick up trash. Throw in bin. Vacuum floor. Move furniture. Wipe table. Turn off TV. Turn off lights.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Use toilet. Flush. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Adjust pillow. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Shift legs. Move arm. Remain asleep.
